name: UK CMA Green Claims
description: UK Competition and Markets Authority & ASA Misleading Advertising Code
note: Rule IDs are our own labels, not official clause numbers, and the descriptions are plain-language summaries.

rules.title: Clear and Accurate Environmental Claims
rules.description: Claims such as 'zero impact', 'carbon zero', or '100% natural' must consider the full lifecycle of the product and cannot omit significant environmental impacts.

rules.title: Upfront Commercial Identifier
rules.description: Commercial communications by affiliates and influencers must be immediately identifiable as marketing (using #Ad clearly visible before engagement).
rules.source: ASA CAP Code Rule 2.1 (Recognition of Marketing Communications)

rules.title: Substantiation of Time-Bound Results
rules.description: Claims promising results within a specific time window ('in 3 days') must have robust human dermatological trials backing the speed claim.
rules.source: ASA CAP Code Rule 3.1 (Misleading Advertising & Substantiation)
